# PaperScope gap：v1 → v2（含 LLM fallback）的 119 题逐 case 审计

分析日期：2026-09-23。只读核验已完成的原实验；没有重新问答、重评打分或改写实验数据库。五组各 119 题，共核对 595 份答案、595 个 agent trace 及其原始 judge 结果。一次性分析脚本在生成、校验报告后清理。

## 1. 结论先行

用户观察成立：相较 v1，v2 naive 的归一化 accuracy 下降 **5.67 个百分点**，普通 community 下降 **4.62 个百分点**，fallback community 相较 v1 community 下降 **4.83 个百分点**。但不是每题、每种模式都下降。

最有解释力的证据链是：**长摘要中的具体限制被删掉 → 常规搜索没有补回对应原文段落 → 答案转为方法贡献、消融或笼统适用范围，漏掉 gold 强调的限制条件。** PBADet 是最清楚的例子。不过，这不是单因素实验；agent prompt、关键词展示、社区划分、ID、向量重新生成与各次模型输出都同时变化，不能把全部差距定量归因于摘要长度。

另外两类问题独立存在：**已经拿到原文却漏用/错用**（如 gap:187 跨论文归属错误），以及 **question/gold 范围不对称、judge 判定不一致**（如 gap:355、244、94、448）。因此首要方向应是保留关键约束、定向验证与答案覆盖检查，同时审计评分；继续扩大社区召回不是 gap 的优先解法。

所有 case 在第 9 节逐题给出分析、五组指标、原判分理由和完整工具调用时序；包括得分相同的题，没有只挑下降样本。第 8 节提供全部 119 题的分数导航。

## 3. 数据与可比性核验

| 记号 | 数据来源 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1N / V1C | 214 `data/runs/paperscope_93_naive_community` | v1 naive / community |
| V2N / V2C | 214 `data/runs/20260922_182040_paperscope_v2_three_modes` | v2 naive / community |
| V2F | 187 `data/runs/20260922_204741_paperscope_v2_llm_split_two_modes` | v2 fallback community；复用 214 的 v2 文档入库 |

只比较 gap，排除 results_comparison、trend 和 community_guide；每组 119/119 问答成功且评测完成。QA ID、question 和 gold_answers 逐条一致。分数为原 LLM judge 的 0–4 分，accuracy=均分，归一化 accuracy=均分/4；它不是二元正确率。QA token 包括检索 embedding，不含入库和 judge；rounds 包括最终回答轮。

文档通过源 PDF 文件名匹配，再核对 93/93 content_hash 一致；5,839/5,839 `(文档, chunk顺序, 正文)` 完全一致。本文统一使用 v2 的 `Dxxxx` 作为分析别名，v1 原数据库/trace 的长 ID 没有改写。原始映射见 [doc_id_mapping.json](/Users/yunhaoz/Developer/MyProjects/community_wiki/data/analysis/20260923_paperscope_gap_v1_v2/doc_id_mapping.json)。

**向量并非完全冻结：**5,839 个 chunk embedding 只有 1,655 个向量的字节完全相同，其余重新生成后存在数值差异；同段向量余弦均值 0.99918177、最低 0.99478211。方向高度接近，但不能声称排序完全相同。仅有相同模型名、temperature=0，也不能证明不同运行时的后端输出严格一致。

v1/v2 naive、v1/v2 community、v2 community/fallback 之间，同题首轮整组工具请求相同均为 **0/119**。首轮查询是在看到返回内容前规划的，不能把其差异归因于该轮尚未注入的社区。历史结果可用于机制线索与回归定位，不能作为“只改 summary”或“只开 fallback”的因果实验。

judge 模板文本一致；question 前缀均保留 `as briefly as possible`，仅 `context.Do` → `context. Do` 多一个空格，不能描述为完全逐字相同，也没有证据认为这个空格解释了退化。模型、chunk 600/overlap 80、chunk_k=12、doc_k=3、图 hybrid/k=15/min_weight=.25/α=.7 等主要参数一致。实际 search_mode 以工具请求为准。

三组 v2 均低于两个 v1 模式的严格共同退化案例有 8 个：[gap:55](#gap-55)、[gap:82](#gap-82)、[gap:94](#gap-94)、[gap:187](#gap-187)、[gap:229](#gap-229)、[gap:241](#gap-241)、[gap:253](#gap-253)、[gap:343](#gap-343)。其余应按具体模式分析，不能统称“新版全线变差”。

以下计数先在每题去重再跨题求和。“595”是 119×5 次标注文档机会，不是 595 篇不同文档。reference 文档是数据集标注，**不保证每篇都被问题要求，也不保证非标注文档都无关**。

| 指标 | V1N | V1C | V2N | V2C | V2F |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 标注文档原文出现次数 / 595 | 587 | 588 | 586 | 586 | 589 |
| 五篇标注文档原文均出现的题数 | 111 | 112 | 110 | 110 | 113 |
| 五篇在原文或overview均出现的题数 | 111 | 116 | 110 | 119 | 119 |
| 社区成员文档出现次数 | 0 | 8,210 | 0 | 7,308 | 6,108 |
| 其中非标注文档出现次数 | 0 | 7,618 | 0 | 6,713 | 5,513 |
| search_chunks 次数 | 934 | 865 | 853 | 852 | 846 |
| read_chunks 次数 | 168 | 179 | 485 | 452 | 422 |
| 工具错误次数 | 8 | 9 | 19 | 3 | 5 |

v2 两种 community 全部 119 题都有五篇标注文档的信息。v1 community 只覆盖全部五篇的有 116 题，却分数更高；因此“找到五篇论文”无法解释主要回归。下降题中五篇原文齐全且无工具错误的，naive 为 35/42，普通 community 为 33/38，fallback 为 44/46。

v2 naive 的 read_chunks 从 168 增至 485，普通 community 从 179 增至 452；平均轮次同时上涨。最终答案平均字符数 V1N/V1C 为 4,401/4,446，V2N/V2C 为 4,536/4,577，fallback 为 4,403；**并没有整体变短**。问题更像信息选择和组织变化，而非统一被“brief”截成更短答案。字符数含中英文、Markdown、ID，只用于长度描述，不等于有效事实量。

普通 v2 community 每题平均展开 61.41 篇成员文档，fallback 为 51.33，v1 为 68.99；其中平均非标注文档分别 56.41、46.33、64.02。这里只能说明展开仍宽，不能把它们全部称为无关噪声。普通→fallback 非标注文档少 1,200 次，是两次实际 trace 的差，包含查询路径变化，不是固定查询下纯聚类净效果。

## 5. 为什么下降：有直接证据的链条与边界

### 5.1 PBADet：摘要删除了原文搜索很少补回的限制

所有 119 题都标注 PBADet（D0063）、JEPA（D0048）与 Dale’s Law（D0069）；101 题还标注 4-bit optimizer（D0059）。因此同一篇常见论文的小遗漏会重复影响许多题，这 119 题不是 119 个完全独立主题。共涉及 57 篇不同 reference 文档。

PBADet v1 summary 明确写：

> On CrowdHuman face-body association it achieves leading body MR-2 and competitive AP, though its advantage over BPJDet is less pronounced for this single-part task.

v2 summary 全文：

> PBADet introduces a one-stage, anchor-free detector for human part-body association, representing each part by a single 2D offset to its parent body center. It outperforms BPJDet on BodyHands, matches or exceeds it on COCOHumanParts, surpasses ED-Pose in part-body association, and generalizes to quadruped animal part-body association.

v2 保留了方法与正向结果，删去了单部件收益较弱和 task-alignment 等细节。这一点也影响 naive：naive 会展示命中文档 overview，不能把 naive 当成“纯 chunk、完全不受摘要改动影响”的对照。

同一条关键结论在两版相同的 D0063/chunk32（附录 A.1）中：

> Consequently, the advantages of our method over BPJDet are not as pronounced as seen in scenarios with multiple parts-to-body associations

| 实际返回关键附录 chunk32 的题数 | V1N | V1C | V2N | V2C | V2F |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 119题中 | 16 | 14 | 14 | 16 | 13 |

多数题即使召回 D0063，仍没读到这一段。v1 可由长摘要补足，v2 需要 agent 主动到附录找证据。[gap:82](#gap-82) 最能说明：五组都未返回 chunk32，v1 4/3 分、v2 三组均 2；v1 答案保留该限制，而 v2 更偏向方法介绍/前代 BPJDet 的缺陷。[gap:49](#gap-49) 则是 v1 naive 实际读到了附录，而其余低分组未读到。

这支持“摘要丢掉限制提示、段落检索未补回”的解释，但不证明单独把摘要恢复到 800 字即可恢复全部分数。v1 摘要本身也会过度概括动物泛化，不能把旧摘要当作绝对正确的标准。

### 5.2 有材料仍漏用：不能把每次失分都归因于摘要缩短

D0059 的零点量化失败机制，在 chunk1/2/8/9 中有直接原文：非零二阶矩量化到零，逆平方根更新会严重偏离。101 道标注该论文的题中，V1N、V1C、V2N、V2C 都是 **101/101** 返回了这些关键段落，fallback 是 **100/101**；但原 judge 仍反复指出最终回答缺失该机制。v2 summary 也保留了 zero-excluding mapping。问题不能只归因于“没检索到”或“摘要删除了所有相关线索”。

[gap:340](#gap-340)：v2 naive 已拿到 PBADet 附录仍从 v1 naive 的 4 降到 2；[gap:265](#gap-265)：两个版本 naive 均 4，三个 community 均 2，五篇原文全到、零工具错误。后者把社区成员从 65/76 减到 45 仍没有改善 PE-DQN / RCPS 等限制覆盖。

### 5.3 长 loop 在追索偏好组合，而不是逐项补缺陷

[gap:55](#gap-55) 的 v2 community：8 轮、16 次工具、0 错误；多轮追问 JEPA 的 CE/MSE/cosine 组合，最后只读 PBADet 21–23，没有读附录32，最终 2 分。[gap:283](#gap-283) 的普通 v2 community 更是 9 轮、20 次工具、0 错误，多次近义改写 softmax/CE 与 JEPA 查询，仍为 2；v1 naive 3轮即4分。

这不是主张彻底禁止探索；[gap:205](#gap-205) 的 fallback 在第3轮并行定向 read 五篇目标论文，其中 D0063=[20,21,31,32]，最终到4分，是更有目标的核验。改进应针对“未解决的事实是什么、下一次读哪段能验证”，而非笼统增加轮数。

### 5.4 跨论文归属错误与“前代问题=本方法缺陷”

[gap:187](#gap-187) 的普通 v2 community 在 AMP（D0041）段实际写道：

> The paper is theoretical; its claims are proven for "deep linear networks with simultaneously diagonalizable covariances"

这是同一上下文里 JEPA（D0048）的理论条件，不能归给 AMP。五篇原文均已到、7轮无工具错误，主要错误发生在综合回答。[gap:94](#gap-94) 的普通 v2 community 也把 ColEI 的 gradient-clipping 证据写进 BSO 段。较大上下文可能增加归属负担，但这些观察不能证明是社区扩展单独造成。

[gap:82](#gap-82) 等答案则把 BPJDet 的 body-to-part offset 随部件增加而复杂/遮挡失效，拿来占据 PBADet 缺陷段；那正是 PBADet 试图修复的前代问题。应核对“这一句批评的对象是谁”，而不只核对关键词共现。

### 5.5 judge 和 gold 本身的范围问题

逐题已确认的范围争议至少包括：

- [gap:103](#gap-103)、[gap:106](#gap-106)、[gap:190](#gap-190)、[gap:280](#gap-280)、[gap:355](#gap-355)、[gap:358](#gap-358)：问题未要求 Dale’s Law 模块，gold 却包括它。
- [gap:241](#gap-241)、[gap:244](#gap-244)：问题关注 HASSOD 等四个模块，gold 另含 PBADet。
- [gap:196](#gap-196)、[gap:199](#gap-199)、[gap:202](#gap-202)、[gap:445](#gap-445)、[gap:448](#gap-448)：问题有多组件，而 gold 主要只详细评 HPO、TuCo 或自动微分一篇。

这些是人工核实的 13 个范围不对称案例，不表示其他 gold 已被证明毫无瑕疵；也不将它们一律改分。尤其 [gap:355](#gap-355)，四组2分的 judge 将 Dale’s Law 未回答作为缺项，而 fallback 4分 judge 明说它不属于用户四个主题、不应扣分。这足以否定把该题 +2 全部归因于 fallback。[gap:244](#gap-244) 也出现未回答 PBADet 却被分别给2与4的范围差异。

[gap:94](#gap-94) 的 v2 naive 原答案明确写 `regret O(√T), O(T^(3/4))`，与文档及 gold 相关阶数一致，judge 却称“significant factual error in ... convergence rates”；该理由有争议，不能据此自动生成“收敛率错误”标签。[gap:448](#gap-448) fallback 确实未充分展开 AD，但 judge 称只弱涉及一点，忽略答案已写的 shared-bias/minibatch 与充分条件，1分的严厉程度也值得盲评复核。**本报告没有自行重新打分，也没有伪造校正 accuracy。**

## 6. 社区与 fallback 在 gap 上目前能确认什么

能确认的是覆盖与成本性质：v2 两种 community 均覆盖每题五篇 reference 的信息；fallback 实际展开成员更少，平均 QA token 比普通 v2 community 少约 10.02%，平均轮次也减少。但是 accuracy 63.66% 对 63.87%，没有整体提升。

不能确认的是把某题所有改善归给社区。查询从首轮即分叉，模型/评测也各只运行一次。正向案例 [gap:7](#gap-7)、[gap:58](#gap-58)、[gap:205](#gap-205)、[gap:208](#gap-208)、[gap:298](#gap-298)、[gap:340](#gap-340)、[gap:346](#gap-346) 表明新版仍可取得充分答案；反例 [gap:265](#gap-265)、[gap:82](#gap-82) 表明社区内容丰富、文档覆盖充分并不自动等于缺陷分析完整。

因此，社区在当前系统更适合当“定位和主题组织”的辅助手段。gap 需要的是每篇方法的条件、失败机制、对比收益、成本及证据归属；不能把社区 overview 或方法摘要当成已经完成这些检查。

## 7. 改进优先级与验证方式（本次不改代码）

| 优先级 | 建议 | 本报告依据 | 如何验证 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0 | 给缺陷分析做逐对象覆盖检查：方法→限制/条件→证据→是否已回答；明确区分前代问题与本方法问题 | gap187/82/265；大量原文齐全仍失分 | 保留相同检索结果，仅改综合步骤，盲评事实与覆盖 |
| P0 | 审计 question/gold 范围，固定 judge 对未问主题和额外内容的规则；对争议答案多次盲评 | gap355/244/94/448 | 冻结现有答案重复评分，报告均值及波动，不将新分覆盖原分 |
| P1 | 摘要保留少量高价值限制/失败条件/适用范围，避免压缩后只剩正向结果 | PBA v1明确single-part caveat，v2删除；附录返回仅13–16题 | 同一索引/embedding/问题，比较350字纯概括、相近长度含边界、较长摘要；不按测试gold定向写入 |
| P1 | 检索从泛化改写转为定向查条件/消融/失败/附录段落；对未证实偏好停止近义追索 | gap55/283对比205 | 记录关键段落命中和实际采用率，检查成本是否下降 |
| P1 | 按文档绑定证据后再综合，检查关键否定句与数值 | AMP混入JEPA、BSO混入ColEI | 离线核验claim所属doc_id，减少归属错误 |
| P2 | 保留fallback作为控制超大社区的可选机制，暂不继续以拆更细为gap主优化方向 | 普通→fallback净−1分；gap265没有改善 | 固定查询重放比较覆盖/展开量，再做端到端重复实验 |
| P2 | 工具范围校验反馈更明确，减少无效read；不将其当准确率回归主因 | 19/3/5次v2工具错误，绝大多数下降题无错误 | 统计纠错轮次与无效token，单独验成本 |

为了确定 v1→v2 的贡献，最少应冻结文档/chunk embedding 和问答模型服务，依次消融：①只换 summary；②只换 agent prompt；③只变关键词展示；④只变社区划分。先固定查询重放衡量提供的信息，再用多次端到端运行衡量 agent 行为。所有优化必须以问题和原文为依据，不能在 QA 时使用测试 gold 或标注 document_ids 来“补齐答案”。

每题表中的 G-raw/G-context 是五篇标注文档的原文/原文或overview覆盖数；C 是去重社区成员数，C−G 是其中非标注文档数。表中覆盖不等于语义相关性或必要性。原 judge 原文是评测证据，不代表本报告无条件认可。关键段落列表只审计了 PBADet32 和 optimizer1/2/8/9，未冒充全 gold 事实的自动真值判定。工具时序列出全部实际调用，查询未截断；原始返回正文可通过每组 trace 链接核验。

<a id="gap-1"></a>

### gap:1

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively address training efficiency and representation quality across the stack: (1) anchor‑free, one‑stage detectors that encode part→body offsets for human part/body association on COCO‑style datasets; (2) analyses of excitatory–inhibitory sign‑constrained RNNs showing how spectral properties (e.g., singular‑value clustering) drive learning and interpretability; (3) theoretical work on joint‑embedding self‑distillation in self‑supervised learning explaining why latent prediction (vs reconstruction) biases feature learning under CE/MSE‑like objectives; (4) memory‑efficient training via ≈4‑bit optimizer states for Adam/AdamW/SGD enabling LoRA/SFT fine‑tuning of Transformer models; and (5) distributionally‑robust reweighting of pretraining domain mixtures to speed up LM pretraining. Prefer studies that report on COCO, MNIST/CIFAR‑100/SVHN, use Transformers or RNNs, and discuss cosine‑similarity metrics, regularization, and interpretability.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v2 fallback 得到 4 分，而普通 community 仍为 2 分，退化并非逐题必然。原 judge 对普通 community 主要扣在 PBADet 的单部件、后处理和成本，以及其他论文条件覆盖；fallback 的进一步原文核验改善了这一题的最终覆盖。不能将整个数据集的均值下降套用到此题。

**V1N（3分）**

> The response correctly identifies most core limitations for all five methods, but it omits several important documented defects (e.g., PBADet post-processing and high-resolution costs, 4-bit coverage gaps and pretraining parity, DoReMi non-uniqueness/compute-budget dependence), making it good rather than perfect.

**V1C（2分）**

> The generated answer captures many correct limitations but omits several important documented defects (e.g., PBADet's hyperparameter sensitivity and post-processing dependence, RNN's network-size/EI-ratio dependence, optimizer-state coverage gaps and pretraining parity), so it is partially complete rather than fully matching the gold answer.

**V2N（3分）**

> The response correctly matches the gold answer's structure and covers the majority of the key development defects for all five methods, but it omits a few non-central details such as the RNN's dependence on network size/E-I ratio, JEPA's depth sensitivity, and 4-bit optimizer's pretraining parity, so it is good but not perfect.

**V2C（2分）**

> The response captures many limitations for the RNN, JEPA, 4-bit optimizer, and DoReMi methods, but it misses key defects for PBADet (e.g., limited single-part gains, post-processing dependencies, narrow evaluation scope, high-resolution cost) and several important caveats in other methods, making it only partially matched to the gold answer.

**V2F（4分）**

> The generated answer fully captures the main documented limitations of all five methods, matching the gold answer's key facts while adding only consistent supporting detail.

**问题：** I’m building a low‑latency multimodal assistant on tight GPUs. I need: an efficient vision module to reliably associate hands/face with the correct person in crowded scenes (COCO‑like), a way to pretrain my Transformer LM faster by automatically rebalancing the web/wiki/code mix (no downstream labels), on‑device instruction/SFT or end‑to‑end LoRA fine‑tuning with minimal memory (e.g., 4‑bit optimizer states under AdamW/SGD), and guidance on choosing an SSL objective that avoids chasing pixel noise (favoring latent prediction over reconstruction with CE/MSE‑style losses). I’m also exploring EI‑constrained recurrent controllers for better interpretability and stability. Can you point me to works that address these needs and compare to common baselines on datasets like COCO, MNIST, CIFAR‑100, or SVHN?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:10

**问题：** I’m building a resource‑constrained multimodal pipeline: an anchor‑free part–body association model for COCO, a text‑conditioned Diffusion module for control that must obey external rewards, and limited‑VRAM fine‑tuning (prefer LoRA + low‑memory AdamW). I also need to diagnose why my self‑supervised pretraining overfits to pixel noise (vs semantics) and whether adding E/I constraints could stabilize a small recurrent block. Can you point me to research that shows how to amortize constrained sampling in Diffusion models (possibly via Flow‑network ideas), reduce optimizer memory with 4‑bit states, explain JEPA vs MAE behavior, design anchor‑free detectors, and analyze Dale’s Law through spectra—ideally with MNIST/CIFAR‑100 evaluations and metrics like F1/AUROC and cosine similarity?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两模式均 3 分；v2 naive 维持 3，普通/fallback community 都降至 2。普通 community 用 5 轮、fallback 仅 2 轮，却都漏掉 PBADet 阈值/单部件及 RTB、optimizer 的具体条件；相同低分既可发生于过早结束，也可发生于长检索后漏用，不能只归因于轮次。

**问题：** I’m looking for a small set of papers that collectively explain how to train deep networks more efficiently and robustly across different modalities and tasks: (1) analyses of training dynamics and spectral diagnostics/regularization in recurrent models that respect excitatory–inhibitory constraints, (2) self-supervised representation learning via self-distillation that predicts in latent space (rather than pixel space) to down‑weight noisy features, (3) memory-lean training using optimizers that store first/second moments at very low precision while keeping Adam/AdamW/SGD‑style behavior and accuracy, (4) graph foundation models that map heterogeneous node attributes into a unified text feature space for cross-graph transfer, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., AUROC/F1), and (5) one‑stage, anchor‑free part–whole detection trained end‑to‑end with classification/regression losses. Ideally these works discuss implicit bias, interpretability, regularization, use feature embeddings (often Transformer/CNN backbones), and report standard downstream metrics (e.g., cross-entropy losses, F1, AUROC) and fine‑tuning protocols.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:25

**问题：** Help me find papers that unify reliable training, inference, and calibration across vision, language, and control systems, including: (1) self-supervised learning that avoids noisy features (e.g., JEPA-style) using MSE/CE losses, cosine similarity, and SGD/Adam; (2) diffusion models with amortized posterior sampling and End-to-end LoRA fine-tuning; (3) anchor-free, part–body association on COCO with Transformers/ResNet-50 backbones; (4) active, online implementation of anytime-valid risk-controlling prediction sets with evaluations on MNIST/CIFAR-100; and (5) deep networks with biologically inspired constraints analyzed via spectral properties. I’m looking for works reporting F1/Precision/AUROC and using datasets like COCO, MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-100, with fine-tuning and feature embeddings.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 两个版本都保持 naive 2、community 3，fallback 也是 3。社区的相对优势在此题复现，但 PBADet 非人类验证、RCPS predictor 质量、RTB credit assignment 等仍未完整展开。

<a id="gap-28"></a>

### gap:28

**问题：** I’m building a multi-modal product: a real-time detector that links hands/face to the correct person in crowded scenes (COCO-like), a text-to-image module that uses a diffusion prior but must respect user prompts via posterior sampling, and an online safety layer that keeps the miscoverage rate under control while labeling only a small MNIST/CIFAR-100-sized stream. I also need my time-series controller to train stably (considering E/I-style constraints and spectral regularization) and I plan to fine-tune large backbones with End-to-end LoRA. Are there papers that cover anchor-free part–body association, amortized inference for diffusion models, active anytime-valid risk control, and self-supervised training that prioritizes useful features over noise, with practical guidance on SGD/Adam, cosine similarity, and evaluation via F1/AUROC?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**问题：** Help me find a concise reading list that spans: (1) a modern, anchor‑free method for associating human parts with people on large benchmarks like COCO; (2) theoretical and empirical analyses explaining the implicit bias of self‑supervised objectives (e.g., MSE vs cross‑entropy) and their interpretability in deep networks; (3) memory‑lean optimizers that replace 32‑bit Adam/AdamW/SGD states with 4‑bit variants suitable for fine‑tuning (including LoRA) on Transformers; (4) a modular library for decision‑making based on diffusion models with transformer‑based conditional guidance; and (5) a study of biologically constrained recurrent nets (excitatory/inhibitory, a.k.a. Dale’s Law) from a spectral perspective. Prefer works that evaluate on datasets like CIFAR‑100/MNIST/COCO, report metrics such as F1/AUROC/Precision, and discuss attention, feature embeddings, and multi‑task learning.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:40

**问题：** I’m building a production system with three needs: (1) a medical vision module that reliably links hands/faces to the right person in crowded rooms (COCO-style benchmarks, anchor-free detection, evaluate with F1/Precision); (2) an LLM service that decides cache contents and ranked lists using only offline logs (bandit-style offline learning, no online exploration); and (3) a training stack for Transformers/ResNet-50 that must fine-tune with self-supervised objectives while keeping optimizer state tiny (prefer 4-bit AdamW/SGD) and steering representations away from noisy features. We also have an RNN component that should obey excitatory/inhibitory constraints but remain trainable via spectral guidance. Are there papers that bring together anchor-free part–body detection, offline combinatorial bandits, JEPA-style self-supervised learning, memory-efficient optimizers, and spectral perspectives on biologically constrained RNNs—using CE/MSE, cosine similarity, and LoRA fine-tuning?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两组 3，v2 naive/fallback 2、普通 community 3。退化集中于 Off-CMAB 单调/平滑假设、PBADet 单部件收益及谱半径约束；补充外围综述没有替代这些方法级限制。

**V2N（2分）**

**V2C（3分）**

Looking for works grounded in deep networks, attention, self-supervised learning, and practical baselines on datasets such as MNIST/SVHN/CIFAR-100.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:55

**问题：** Help me find papers that modify training-time behavior to improve generalization and efficiency across deep networks: (1) adding stochastic perturbations to feature embeddings during instruction fine-tuning of Transformers; (2) studying joint-embedding predictive objectives that learn in latent space and their implicit bias under mean‑squared vs. cross‑entropy losses and angular (cosine) similarity; (3) compressing Adam/AdamW optimizer states to ultra‑low precision (≈4‑bit) for memory‑limited fine‑tuning; (4) analyzing spectral properties and interpretability of recurrent models that obey an excitatory/inhibitory constraint (Dale’s principle); and (5) one‑stage, anchor‑free part‑to‑whole association for human parts on COCO. Prefer works that discuss regularization during fine‑tuning, self‑supervised learning, attention‑based Transformers, and empirical results on benchmarks like COCO/MNIST/CIFAR‑100.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:58

**问题：** I’m deploying a memory‑constrained instruction‑tuning pipeline (parameter‑efficient adapters/LoRA, AdamW) for a Transformer and want better chat quality without hurting OpenLLM metrics (we monitor F1/AUROC and use CE/MSE heads with cosine‑style similarities). I also need: (a) a trick that injects noise into feature embeddings during SFT to boost conversational responses; (b) an optimizer that stores first/second moments in ~4‑bit to cut GPU memory; (c) a simple one‑stage, anchor‑free method to associate hands/face/feet to the correct person on COCO; (d) references on self‑supervised joint‑embedding prediction that avoids learning noisy pixels; and (e) a spectral analysis of E/I‑partitioned RNNs (Dale’s law) explaining learning stability/implicit bias. Which papers cover these pieces end‑to‑end so my vision and language teams can adopt them?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 community 2，v2 普通 3、fallback 4，是稳定改善例。NEFTune 的评估偏差/机制和 PBADet 非统一优势得到不同程度补足，额外核验有收益；不支持仅按社区大小判断质量。

### gap:61

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively examine how structural inductive biases and resource constraints shape learning across vision, sequence models, self-supervised pretraining, and decision-making: (a) one-stage, no-anchor human part–person association evaluated on large human/body benchmarks (e.g., common object corpora); (b) recurrent networks with strict E/I separation analyzed via their spectrum to stabilize SGD-style training on classic sequences (e.g., digit streams) and natural data; (c) joint-embedding self-supervised methods that prefer predictive latent targets over pixel reconstruction, comparing regression-like losses to classification-style objectives; (d) memory-lean first/second-moment optimizers (e.g., quantized Adam/AdamW) that support Transformers and parameter-efficient end-to-end tuning (e.g., LoRA) on NLU/vision/MT and instruction-following tasks; and (e) combinatorial RL for slate selection using discrete-choice (MNL-like) preference feedback with theoretical regret guarantees. Prefer studies reporting results on COCO-style human datasets, MNIST/CIFAR-100-type benchmarks, and transformer-based encoders.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 五组全为 2。MNL-VQL 的 realizability、κ/H 依赖和 PBADet 后处理/资源条件长期缺失；v1 naive 8 轮与 v2 naive 3 轮得分相同，轮次缩减未造成本题新增损失。

### gap:64

**问题：** I’m building a production system that: detects and links body parts to the right person on common object datasets; pretrains encoders with joint-embedding SSL to avoid overfitting to pixel noise; trains under tight GPU memory by using low-precision moment states while still fine-tuning attention models end-to-end (e.g., with LoRA); enforces an excitatory/inhibitory split in recurrent modules for time-series stability via spectral control; and deploys a slate recommendation policy trained from user choice signals (discrete-choice style) with provable efficiency. Can you point me to research covering these pieces—covering optimization (SGD/AdamW), reconstruction vs predictive losses (MSE vs CE), and transformer-based pipelines—that has results on COCO-like, MNIST/CIFAR-100, and modern NLU/MT benchmarks?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:67

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (a) single-pass, anchor-free human part-to-body association on COCO-style datasets and report standard losses (MSE, cross-entropy) and metrics (Precision, F1); (b) the learning dynamics of recurrent nets with biologically inspired excitatory/inhibitory separation, analyzed via spectral properties (e.g., singular-value distributions, entropy) under SGD/AdamW; (c) self-supervised joint-embedding predictive training that biases latent features toward high-influence signals (beyond raw pixel variance), with demonstrations on MNIST/CIFAR-100 and Transformer/ResNet-50 backbones; (d) memory-efficient optimization using sub-byte (≈4-bit) states for Adam/AdamW with block/group quantization and handling zero-point issues; and (e) uncertainty-aware reinforcement learning using ensembles of value distributions where disagreement (e.g., 1-Wasserstein) drives exploration. Prefer works discussing interpretability, attention, and common evaluation protocols.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

<a id="gap-70"></a>

### gap:70

**问题：** I’m building an interactive vision and robotics system with tight GPU memory: we need robust per-person hand/face detection in crowded scenes (one-stage, anchor-free on COCO-like data) and an exploration-heavy control module where an RL agent uses distributional value ensembles to guide behavior via disagreement; our representation learning stack favors latent-space prediction to avoid noisy pixels for a feedforward classifier; training must fit in memory by using low-bit optimizer states for AdamW; and our time-series module should keep biologically plausible E/I separation in RNNs while remaining trainable. Are there papers that address these needs and discuss standard losses (MSE, CE), optimizers (SGD/Adam/AdamW), attention/Transformers, interpretability, and benchmarks like MNIST/CIFAR-100?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 community 4→v2 2，fallback 部分恢复至 3；naive 均 2。PE-DQN uncertainty propagation/bonus decay 和 PBADet 算力/解码条件未完整落地。fallback 增加一轮后有所改善，但未恢复满分。

### gap:73

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively address: (1) avoiding local and global dimensional collapse in self-supervised learning via local intrinsic dimensionality regularization and analysis of feature embeddings; (2) the implicit bias of joint-embedding predictive approaches compared to reconstruction (e.g., how cosine-similarity vs. MSE objectives shape learned features); (3) memory-efficient fine-tuning with 4-bit optimizer states for Adam/AdamW and SGD on Transformers and ResNet-50; (4) spectral perspectives on recurrent networks under excitatory/inhibitory constraints for interpretability; and (5) a one-stage anchor-free method for associating detected human parts to the correct body, evaluated on COCO. I’m looking for works reporting results on datasets like ImageNet, COCO, CIFAR-100, and MNIST, using losses such as cosine similarity and cross-entropy (CE), and discussing regularization strategies, fine-tuning, and practical metrics.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 community 4，v2 普通 3、fallback 2，naive 反而 2→3。LDReg 的 LID 估计与实现风险、optimizer 二阶矩零点问题和 PBADet 的具体边界导致模式间不同方向变化；同为 4 轮仍可相差 2 分。

### gap:76

**问题：** I am building a vision pipeline for a hospital HMI: cameras must detect hands/faces and reliably link them to the right person in crowded scenes, with a single-stage anchor-free detector evaluated on COCO. The backbone will be pretrained via self-supervised learning (we use cosine-similarity and MSE objectives) and then fine-tuned under tight GPU memory, so we need 4-bit optimizer states for Adam/AdamW/SGD. We also want to prevent local/global representation collapse, use Transformers plus some recurrent modules that respect biologically inspired excitatory/inhibitory constraints for interpretability, and validate on CIFAR-100/MNIST. Please point me to research on joint-embedding predictive learning, dimensionality regularization of feature embeddings, memory-efficient optimizers for fine-tuning, and anchor-free part-to-body association.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 community 4→v2 普通/fallback 3；naive 2→3。v1 naive 曾漏 EI 整个模块；新版更多是 LID 高维估计、JEPA bias 与量化细节遗漏。应区分整模块覆盖改善与细节完整性下降。

### gap:85

**问题：** Help me find papers discussing a coherent toolkit for efficient and principled representation learning and training: (a) anchor‑free, one‑stage part–whole human detection on large‑scale benchmarks; (b) spectral/implicit‑bias analyses of recurrent nets with excitatory–inhibitory sign constraints for improved interpretability; (c) why joint‑embedding predictive self‑distillation (latent‑space prediction with squared error) can outperform pixel reconstruction and how it filters noisy features; (d) memory‑lean optimizers that store first/second moments in sub‑byte precision (around 4‑bit) for fine‑tuning Transformer models; and (e) theory and practice for learning from video‑only data to pretrain representations for downstream RL under both iid and exogenous noise. Prefer works that employ standard stochastic optimizers (SGD/Adam/AdamW), squared‑error objectives, and report results on common benchmarks (e.g., COCO‑style detection, MNIST/Sequential MNIST) and modern vision/NLP backbones.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:94

**问题：** I’m building a resource-constrained edge AI system that must (a) associate hands/face to the right person in real time from video, (b) run on spiking/binary hardware with online updates, and (c) fine-tune large models under strict GPU memory using 4-bit optimizer states and LoRA-style end-to-end adaptation. I need research that shows anchor-free part–body association detection, online training for binary/spiking nets with temporal inputs, spectral diagnostics for EI-restricted recurrent blocks in time-series modeling (e.g., sequential MNIST), and self-supervised predictive encoders that avoid noisy features compared to reconstruction. Demonstrations on CIFAR-100 or similar and metrics like CE, Precision, and F1 would be ideal.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两组均 4，v2 naive 2、两社区 3。v2 naive 答案实际写了正确的 regret O(√T)/O(T^(3/4))，原 judge 却称收敛率有重大错误，需标记评分争议；但 PBADet tuning/不统一收益等真实遗漏仍存在。普通 v2 community 还把 ColEI clipping 证据放进 BSO 段，存在跨文档归属混淆。 因此该例不能直接按 judge 所称“收敛率错误”归类；工具参数越界确实存在，随后被纠正。

### gap:97

**问题：** Help me find a concise set of recent papers that together cover: (1) an anchor‑free, one‑stage approach to associating human parts (hands/feet/face) to the correct person on COCO‑style whole‑body splits; (2) training recurrent networks that obey E/I sign constraints via a spectral (singular‑value) perspective, with results on sequential MNIST and Penn Treebank; (3) why joint‑embedding predictive pretraining in self‑supervised learning prioritizes high‑influence features over pixel reconstruction, analyzed in deep linear nets with ImageNet/CIFAR‑100 comparisons; (4) memory‑efficient optimizers storing Adam/AdamW moments in ~4 bits that preserve accuracy when fine‑tuning Transformers (e.g., LLaMA/LoRA and Swin‑T on ImageNet/GLUE); and (5) a hybrid RL method mixing offline batches with on‑policy natural‑gradient updates and provable guarantees (e.g., Comblock with CLIP features from CIFAR‑100). Ideally these works mention COCO, MNIST, SGD/AdamW, Transformers, and fine‑tuning.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v2 naive/fallback 升 3，v1 两组及 v2 普通 community 为 2。HNPG 的离线覆盖假设、optimizer 量化边界仍是短板；普通 v2 community 对 CIFAR-100 的否定被 judge 扣分，属于事实范围核验而非召回文档不足。

### gap:100

**问题：** I’m building an edge‑constrained system that needs: (a) reliable hand/face‑to‑person association in crowded images at COCO scale; (b) label‑free pretraining that predicts one view’s representation from another instead of reconstructing pixels; (c) a recurrent controller that respects separate excitatory vs inhibitory units yet still trains well; (d) a policy learner that can start from a static log and keep improving with on‑policy updates while retaining theoretical stability; and (e) the ability to fine‑tune Transformer backbones/LLMs under tight VRAM using ~4‑bit AdamW states. Are there recent papers that collectively address these components, with experiments spanning COCO, CIFAR‑100/MNIST/PTB and common fine‑tuning setups?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 3→v2 naive 4，社区三组均 2。HAC/HNPG 理论常数、PBADet enclosure 和 JEPA collapse/depth 细节未被社区答案完整采用。此题社区退化早于 v2，不应全算作新版回归。

I’m interested in links to regularization under cross-entropy, practical optimizer choices, and how to keep GPU memory low during training.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:109

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively advance efficient and robust deep learning across: (1) one-stage, anchor-free part–body association; (2) spectral analysis of excitatory–inhibitory constrained recurrent nets under biological sign rules; (3) joint-embedding self-distillation in self-supervised learning that prioritizes influential features over noisy pixel reconstruction (contrasting cosine metrics with mean-squared error and cross-entropy); (4) memory-efficient training via low-bit (around 4-bit) optimizer states for Transformers/ResNet-50 with end-to-end LoRA-style fine-tuning; and (5) linear-time independence testing using learned Fourier feature embeddings. I care about practical runtime near O(n) in sample size, feature embeddings, and evaluation with F1/Precision.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 与 fallback 为 2，另三组为 3。ResNet-50/LoRA 是否覆盖的否定句与 LFHSIC gamma approximation、PBADet 部分性能陈述引发扣分；这是过度否定和具体事实核验问题，不只是假设摘要太短。

### gap:190

**问题：** I’m building a resource-constrained pipeline: a vision module must reliably link hands/face to the correct person in crowded, COCO-like scenes; a graph component needs to capture long-range dependencies without getting stuck by oversmoothing/oversquashing; my self-supervised pretraining should avoid noisy pixels by predicting in latent space; and I have to fine-tune with Adam/SGD under tight GPU memory, ideally via 4-bit optimizer states, while tracking CE/MSE and F1/Precision on CIFAR-100/COCO with Transformer/ResNet-50 backbones. Which works address these needs end-to-end?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 问题只要求 PBADet、AMP、JEPA、低位优化器；gold 多出 Dale’s Law。v2 naive 提升至 3，其他 2，部分扣分来自这个额外主题；不能把缺少它全部解释为失败召回。

### gap:193

**问题：** Help me find papers on improving training and inference efficiency and stability in deep networks that collectively cover: (a) making adaptive moment methods (e.g., decoupled-weight-decay variants of Adam) and first-order SGD usable with sub-byte state storage for full-precision accuracy; (b) curvature-aware regularization beyond quadratic for hyper-parameter search when the objective is non-differentiable or discrete (e.g., maximizing F1/Precision on standard vision benchmarks like MNIST/SVHN/CIFAR-100) and gradients are unavailable; (c) explaining the inductive bias of non-contrastive joint-embedding self-supervised learning (teacher–student in latent space) toward useful feature embeddings rather than pixel noise under CE/MSE losses; (d) understanding how enforcing excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints changes the spectrum and learning dynamics of deep recurrent models; and (e) anchor-free, one-stage part-to-body association detectors that report metrics such as Precision/F1. I’m especially interested in works that discuss regularization choices, approximations, and how these methods integrate with AdamW/SGD and end-to-end fine-tuning (including low-rank adapters).Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:196

**问题：** I’m building a real-time vision system for a hospital robot that must tell a technician’s hand from a patient’s and link each hand to the correct person in crowded scenes. The device runs on a tight GPU budget, so I need memory-lean optimizers (sub‑8‑bit states) that still work with AdamW/SGD during end-to-end fine-tuning (sometimes with low‑rank adapters). Our evaluation metric is F1/Precision on non-differentiable validation criteria, so I also need a hyper-parameter search method that doesn’t rely on hyper‑gradients and can leverage curvature (beyond simple quadratic penalties). We pretrain with a joint-embedding self-teaching setup and want to understand why this avoids focusing on noisy pixels and yields robust feature embeddings. Finally, our control stack uses recurrent modules with excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints inspired by biology, so I need guidance on spectral conditions for stable training. Are there works that address these needs together and report results on standard image datasets before deployment?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 问题涉及多个组件，但 gold 主要评 cubic-regularized HPO。v2 naive 3，其他 2；HPO 的 stochastic relaxation、低维假设、ρ 调参和下层优化成本是关键。固定按五篇平均分配回答篇幅会与此 gold 的权重冲突。

### gap:199

**问题：** Help me find a compact set of papers that, taken together, cover: (1) anchor-free, one-stage human part–to–body association on common object benchmarks (think the dataset used in mainstream detection challenges like COCO) with Transformer-style backbones; (2) memory-lean training via quantizing stateful optimizer buffers to around 4 bits while preserving Adam/AdamW or SGD behavior; (3) self-supervised joint-embedding objectives that prefer predictive, high-influence features over pixel-level MSE reconstruction (with analyses in deep linear nets and cosine-similarity space); (4) per-prompt interpretability for alignment—measuring how much supervised fine-tuning contributes at inference and relating it to jailbreak success (e.g., AUROC/F1/Precision reporting); and (5) recurrent models constrained by excitatory/inhibitory partitions (Dale-like) analyzed through spectra/entropy of singular values. Prefer works that touch standard datasets (MNIST/CIFAR-100/COCO), use Transformers/RNNs, and discuss common losses (cross-entropy, MSE) and feature embeddings.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** gold 仅集中 TuCo，问题却包含多个模块。v2 naive 3，其余 2；last-token、residual-stream 架构及 fine-tuning 数据归因的限制没写全。社区全覆盖不能解决答案重点与 reference 的不对称。

### gap:202

**问题：** I’m building a safety‑critical, resource‑constrained system: a gesture‑driven interface that must (a) detect hands/face and correctly link them to the right person, (b) pretrain encoders with a joint‑embedding SSL objective instead of pixel reconstruction, (c) quantify—per prompt—how much instruction/SFT fine‑tuning is shaping each answer (and spot when jailbreaks suppress that effect, e.g., via AUROC), (d) keep a small recurrent control loop that respects E/I separation yet remains trainable, and (e) fit training into tight VRAM using low‑bit optimizer states while sticking to Adam/SGD on standard benchmarks (COCO/CIFAR‑100/MNIST) and reporting F1/Precision. I’d prefer Transformer/RNN solutions and possibly adapter‑style, end‑to‑end parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning. Which papers should I read to cover all these pieces?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:205

**问题：** Help me find a small set of papers that, taken together, cover: (1) anchor‑free part‑to‑object association in vision (e.g., hand/face to person) with detection heads trained using common losses like cross‑entropy and MSE and evaluated by F1/Precision/AUROC on datasets such as MNIST/CIFAR‑100/SVHN; (2) analysis of deep networks under neurobiological excitatory/inhibitory constraints using spectral tools (e.g., singular value distributions, normalized entropy) and their impact on SGD/AdamW training; (3) joint‑embedding self‑distillation methods that bias toward high‑influence features (often measured via cosine similarity) rather than pixel‑level reconstruction; (4) sub‑8‑bit (e.g., 4‑bit) optimizer‑state quantization for Transformers/ResNet‑50 with end‑to‑end fine‑tuning (including LoRA-style setups) using AdamW; and (5) rigorous sample‑complexity guarantees for differentially private optimization on nonsmooth, nonconvex objectives, including single‑pass and multi‑pass algorithms. I’m looking for works that collectively address these themes across optimization, representation learning, spectral analysis, privacy, and efficient detection.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** fallback 从普通 v2 community 的 2 升到 4，也超过 v1 3/2。它增加到 5 轮、5 次 read，并实际取得 PBADet 附录第 32 chunk；DP/optimizer 细节也更完整，是有目标原文核验成功的例子，不能全归功于社区拆分。

**问题：** I’m building a privacy‑sensitive, multi‑person gesture interface that detects specific hands/faces and links them to the correct individual in real time, but I have tight GPU memory budgets and must comply with differential privacy. I’d like to pretrain with a joint‑embedding self‑distillation approach that avoids noisy pixel details, run recurrent components that respect neuro‑inspired excitatory/inhibitory constraints, and fine‑tune a Transformer backbone using AdamW with 4‑bit optimizer states. I also need theory on sample‑efficient DP for nonsmooth, nonconvex losses, and practical detection pipelines evaluated with F1/Precision/AUROC on benchmarks like MNIST/CIFAR‑100. Are there a few papers that together cover these needs end‑to‑end?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:211

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (1) memory-lean training with low-bit Adam/AdamW-style optimizer states for fine-tuning; (2) efficient gradient computation for diffusion generative models via continuous adjoints; (3) joint-embedding self-distillation and its implicit bias on feature embeddings measured by similarity metrics (e.g., cosine) and standard losses (MSE/CE); (4) spectral properties of excitatory/inhibitory recurrent deep networks trained with stochastic gradient methods for time-series modeling; and (5) an anchor-free, one-stage approach to associate human parts to bodies with detection metrics (AP/F1/Precision).Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 五组均 2。AdjointDEIS 的 SDE/高 NFE、PBADet body-box/标签粒度和 optimizer 零点反复未完整覆盖；从 2 轮到 5 轮无改善，是应增加核验目标而非增加预算的例子。

### gap:214

**问题：** I’m building an edge ML pipeline that: detects hands/face and links them to the correct person in crowded scenes with high Precision/F1; fine-tunes models under tight VRAM using Adam-like optimizers with low-bit states; guides diffusion-model image generation by optimizing a differentiable objective using adjoint methods; learns robust representations with a joint-embedding approach (using similarity in the embedding space rather than pixel-wise MSE); and explores EI-constrained RNNs for control/time-series tasks without sacrificing training stability. Are there works that address these needs across training efficiency, gradient computation for diffusion models, representation learning biases, spectral analysis in deep networks, and anchor-free part–body association?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:217

**问题：** Help me find a small set of works that collectively cover: (1) efficient one-stage, anchor-free vision methods for associating human parts with bodies (contrasting with heavier O(nD(dx+dy+D)) pipelines); (2) training deep networks under biological E/I constraints (Dale-like rules), analyzing spectral properties and stability (e.g., normalized SVD entropy) with SGD/Adam; (3) the implicit bias of joint-embedding vs reconstruction objectives in self-supervised learning (self-distillation vs MAE), comparing CE vs MSE and cosine-similarity of feature embeddings on linearized or MNIST/CIFAR-style setups; (4) active, anytime-valid risk-controlling prediction sets with online calibration and label budgeting, reporting AUROC/Precision/F1; and (5) text-space graph foundation models that align diverse graphs via language features, using Transformers/vision–language encoders, in-context learning, and (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning. Prefer papers that discuss early stopping, calibration, and robust evaluation.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 前四组 3，fallback 2。RCPS predictor 质量/保守性/预算及 GFM forgetting/scalability/feature-loss 没覆盖全；fallback 与普通 community 都 4 轮，未体现省轮优势。

### gap:220

**问题：** I’m building a multi-modal system that: (a) detects and tracks hands/face relative to a person in real time, (b) fuses heterogeneous graph data by mapping attributes to text and then learns across datasets with a unified backbone, (c) pretrains representations with self-supervised objectives that avoid noisy features (favoring joint-embedding over masked reconstruction), (d) guarantees online safety via anytime-valid risk control while actively budgeting labels, and (e) uses recurrent controllers for time-series modeling that respect excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints yet remain trainable and stable. We fine-tune Transformers/vision-language models (possibly with LoRA), optimize with Adam/SGD and CE losses, compare cosine similarity, and monitor AUROC/F1. Can you point me to papers that jointly address these components end-to-end so I can design the detection, SSL, graph unification, and online calibration stack?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:226

**问题：** I’m building a resource-constrained AI stack for materials discovery and human–robot interfaces: we need (a) self-supervised pretraining that avoids noisy features (MSE vs CE) before fine-tuning, (b) a one-stage anchor-free detector that associates hands/faces to bodies on COCO-like data with strong Precision/F1, (c) a language-to-structure generator that uses Transformers, Diffusion models, and a GNN to propose low-energy crystals, (d) Adam/AdamW variants with tiny optimizer states for efficient updates, and (e) guidance on designing EI-constrained RNNs with spectral diagnostics for interpretability. Which papers collectively address these needs, including tips for End-to-end LoRA fine-tuning?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

I’m also comparing latent‑space prediction vs pixel reconstruction objectives (MSE vs CE) and want works that use cosine similarity probes and standard stochastic optimizers (Adam/AdamW/SGD). **问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: 1) anchor‑free part–body association in object detection using multi‑scale features and attention, reporting AP/Precision/Recall/F1; 2) spectral and interpretability analyses of deep networks that enforce excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints, including training with SGD and losses like MSE/cross‑entropy and diagnostics based on singular values and cosine similarity; 3) the implicit bias of joint‑embedding self‑distillation versus masked reconstruction objectives (optimized by MSE) in feedforward classifiers and Transformers (e.g., CIFAR‑100), and how feature embeddings evolve; 4) memory‑efficient training with 4‑bit optimizer states for AdamW that support end‑to‑end LoRA fine‑tuning; and 5) cross‑domain policy adaptation in RL via value‑guided filtering of source transitions under limited target interactions. I’m especially interested in practical fine‑tuning setups (ResNet‑50/LLaMA), reporting diagrams of training dynamics over t, and metrics like Precision/F1.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:238

**问题：** I’m deploying a resource‑constrained robot that needs reliable hand/face detection for a gesture UI, end‑to‑end LoRA fine‑tuning of a Transformer under tight GPU memory, guidance on whether a joint‑embedding self‑distillation (using MSE) beats reconstruction for pretraining, spectral tools to keep an excitatory/inhibitory RNN controller stable, and a way to transfer a sim policy to the real robot with only a small online budget by filtering source data using value targets. Are there works that cover these needs, including practical SGD/AdamW settings, attention/feature embedding design, and evaluation with Precision/F1?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 4→v2 naive 3，两个普通社区都 2，fallback 3。v2 community 比 v1 多两轮仍没补全 shared state/action、PBADet/optimizer 条件。fallback 有改善但未恢复 naive v1，不能单凭上下文更广判成功。

### gap:247

**问题：** Help me find papers on end-to-end training of deep networks under tight constraints that collectively cover: (1) memory-efficient optimization with ~4-bit states for fine-tuning large models; (2) the implicit bias of joint-embedding self-distillation compared to input-space reconstruction (analyzing mean-squared error vs cross-entropy and cosine-like similarity in feature embeddings); (3) anchor-free part–body association detectors; (4) reinforcement-learning-based adaptive sampling with neural denoising for real-time path tracing; and (5) spectral perspectives on biologically constrained excitatory/inhibitory recurrent networks. I’m especially interested in works that use attention/Transformer-style components, report Precision-type metrics, and rely on principled approximations when exact gradients are unavailable.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

<a id="gap-253"></a>

### gap:253

**问题：** Find research that improves deep networks’ efficiency, stability, and interpretability across architectures: (1) transformer-based modules that execute symbolic rules via attention for exact arithmetic with clear reasoning traces; (2) analyses of recurrent models under biologically inspired E/I sign constraints (Dale’s law) using spectral tools to explain training stability; (3) theory of non-contrastive joint-embedding self-distillation versus reconstruction objectives (e.g., JEPA vs MAE) showing biases under MSE/CE losses; (4) memory‑saving optimizers that quantize first/second moments to 4‑bit yet match Adam/SGD fine‑tuning accuracy; and (5) one‑stage, anchor‑free detectors that learn part‑to‑whole associations with attention‑like offsets. Prefer works using Transformers/attention, feature embeddings, cross‑entropy and MSE metrics, fine‑tuning (incl. parameter‑efficient methods), and reporting precision on benchmarks like MNIST/CIFAR for interpretability.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两组 3→三组 v2 全 2。CoNN vocabulary/推理开销与收益幅度、optimizer factorization/FSDP、PBADet 单部件/跨域仅定性证据遗漏；增加至 fallback 5 轮仍没有恢复。

### gap:256

**问题：** I’m building an end‑to‑end system under tight GPU memory: an HCI module must robustly associate hands/faces to the correct person in crowded scenes; our LLM must perform exact multi‑digit arithmetic without tool calls; our SSL pretraining seems to chase noisy pixels; and our small RNN control loop must remain stable under E/I constraints. I’m looking for papers on: anchor‑free part–whole association detectors; compiled attention programs that plug into Transformers for rule‑based symbolic operations; 4‑bit state optimizers that keep Adam‑level accuracy for fine‑tuning (compatible with LoRA); analyses of joint‑embedding self‑distillation (vs reconstruction) explaining biases via MSE/CE; and spectral perspectives on Dale’s law for training stability. We rely on attention/Transformers, SGD/Adam, regularization and interpretability, and care about precision under edge‑device constraints.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

I also need a stable RNN component for time‑series behaviors that aligns with biological E/I dynamics, a self‑supervised pretraining approach that avoids latching onto noisy pixels, an anchor‑free detector to associate parts with the whole (COCO‑like evaluation), and a rigorous benchmark to test VLM reasoning and trait grounding with metrics like F1, Precision, and AUROC. What papers cover these pieces end‑to‑end?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:265

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively address principled uncertainty and inductive-bias–aware learning across deep networks: (a) distributional approaches and ensemble disagreement for exploration in reinforcement learning, (b) joint-embedding self-distillation that prioritizes informative features in self-supervised learning, (c) spectral or structural constraints (e.g., excitatory/inhibitory partitions) that affect RNN training dynamics, (d) anytime-valid calibration that controls prediction risk under adaptive data collection, and (e) anchor-free perception models that associate human parts to bodies in images. Prefer works that use standard optimizers (SGD/Adam), common losses (cross-entropy or mean squared error), CNN/Transformer backbones, and evaluations on familiar vision benchmarks (e.g., COCO, MNIST), reporting metrics like precision/F1 or AUROC and analyzing feature embeddings or cosine similarity.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:268

**问题：** I’m building an end-to-end system where a robot must read hand/pose cues from cameras, explore a new environment safely, and provide predictions with statistically controlled risk while learning on the fly. I need: a robust anchor-free detector that links body parts to the correct person (COCO-scale images, CNN/Transformer backbones, CE/MSE training with Adam/SGD); an exploration module that uses distributional value functions and ensemble diversity to handle epistemic vs. aleatoric uncertainty; a recurrent controller whose stability benefits from biologically inspired E/I constraints and good spectral properties; a self-supervised pretraining recipe (joint-embedding) that avoids noisy features in learned representations; and an anytime-valid calibration method that guarantees low risk under adaptive labeling. Can you point me to research that ties these pieces together and reports standard metrics like precision/F1 or AUROC on benchmarks (e.g., MNIST/COCO), leveraging feature embeddings and cosine similarity?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两组 3→v2 2/2，fallback 3。PE-DQN contraction/compute、RCPS predictor/regret、PBADet heavy setup 的事实密度决定评分；fallback 的恢复不是来自新增完整的标注文档覆盖。

**V1C（3分）**

> The generated answer accurately captures most core development defects and adds relevant metrics/context, but it omits several specific caveats from the gold answer (e.g., PE-DQN contraction/compute constraints, RCPS predictor-quality/regret dependence, JEPA depth/MAE trade-offs), so it is strong but not perfect.

**V2N（2分）**

**V2C（2分）**

**V2F（3分）**

> The generated answer accurately captures most core defects across the methods, but it omits several specific gold-listed limitations and slightly mischaracterizes PE-DQN's evaluation scope, so it is good but not perfect.

### gap:271

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (1) one-stage, anchor-free perception methods that link body parts to their parent instance; (2) spectral perspectives on recurrent networks with excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints (Dale’s Law) and how such spectra influence learning dynamics under SGD/AdamW; (3) analyses of joint-embedding self-supervised objectives versus pixel reconstruction (e.g., explaining when representation learning avoids noisy features in deep networks); (4) memory-frugal training via ~4-bit optimizer states for AdamW/SGD to enable fine-tuning on image benchmarks like MNIST/CIFAR-100 and attention/Transformer backbones; and (5) discovering general reinforcement learning updates via adversarial/teacher-designed curricula. Please emphasize generalization, interpretability, attention mechanisms, and practical online implementation.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 全部 3。普通 v2 community 将 single-part CrowdHuman 的场景说成 COCOHumanParts，被判轻微事实不精确；它和 v2 naive 都多于 v1 community 两轮，成本上升但评分不动。

Are there works that address these combined needs across self-supervised learning, optimizer efficiency, spectral properties with Dale’s Law, anchor-free part–body detection, and adversarial curriculum design for RL?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:283

**问题：** Help me find papers that, across vision and language, study how representation-level choices and training procedures influence reliability and performance: for example, adding noise to learned token embeddings during post-training adaptation of attention-based models; joint-embedding predictive setups in self-supervised learning analyzed under mean‑squared vs softmax cross‑entropy losses; biologically constrained recurrent nets with separate excitatory/inhibitory units examined through their singular-value spectra; and sequential calibration methods that give anytime‑valid risk control with active labeling. I’m also looking for a one‑stage detector without anchors that associates human parts to their parent person on standard detection benchmarks, trained with stochastic gradient descent or adaptive moment optimizers on convolutional backbones with multi‑scale features, and evaluated with metrics like AUROC/F1 or perplexity.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 3 轮 4 分；v2 naive 8 轮、community 9 轮仍 2。naive 的 4 次工具错误增加成本，但 community 零错误也低分；NEFTune/RCPS 条件、MAE noise bias 与 DANN scope 未覆盖。长 loop 不等于更高质量。

### gap:292

**问题：** I’m deploying a resource‑constrained system that must: (a) robustly detect which person’s hands/face belong to which body for gesture control, (b) ship a coding copilot fine‑tuned via supervised/instruction tuning, and (c) train efficiently on limited GPUs. I need references on: an anchor‑free part–body detector for multi‑person scenes; instruction‑tuning of code LLMs on permissive data; optimizer state compression to 4‑bit for Adam‑style training; why latent‑space prediction in self‑supervised setups outperforms pixel reconstruction for useful features; and how E/I (Dale‑style) constraints change RNN spectra and stability. We’ll evaluate with Precision/F1 and cosine‑similarity probes, train with CE/MSE losses using SGD/AdamW, and prefer lightweight, end‑to‑end LoRA updates. Which papers fit this end‑to‑end pipeline?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:298

**问题：** I’m building a resource‑constrained ML stack that must (1) fine‑tune large Transformers under tight VRAM using AdamW—ideally with 4‑bit optimizer states or LoRA, (2) keep recurrent modules stable via spectrum‑aware design in line with biological constraints, (3) understand why self‑distillation (JEPA‑style) resists noisy features compared to CE/MSE training, (4) auto‑construct interpretable causal graphs from tabular, time‑series, and MRI data using an LLM+DSCM workflow, and (5) deploy an anchor‑free one‑stage detector to associate hands/faces with bodies for HCI. I’m looking for papers demonstrating these pieces with metrics like F1/AUROC/Precision on datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR‑100, and COCO, and using cosine‑similarity or cross‑entropy objectives.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:301

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (1) a one-stage, anchor-free approach for linking detected human parts (e.g., hands, face) to the correct person and reporting AP/F1 and Precision; (2) spectral stability analysis for recurrent deep networks that respect excitatory/inhibitory sign constraints (Dale’s principle), going beyond simple sign clipping; (3) self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (non-contrastive self distillation) and its implicit bias toward high-influence features vs pixel reconstruction, with cosine-based similarity and log-loss used in downstream linear probes on a 100‑class image benchmark (e.g., CIFAR‑100); (4) training at scale with memory‑savvy optimizers that keep first/second moments in ~4‑bit while remaining compatible with Adam‑style decoupled weight decay and stochastic gradient descent fine‑tuning on attention/backbone models like a 50‑layer residual net or Transformers; and (5) learning‑augmented online algorithms that, with bandit access to multiple predictors, combine heuristics for metrical task systems and achieve sublinear regret. I’m specifically interested in work that mentions cross‑entropy, cosine similarity, F1/Precision, clean subset evaluation sets like D_k^c, and uses transformer‑based conditional guidance or similar, with near‑linear runtime in problem size.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 2→v2 3，普通社区都 3，fallback 2。bandit MTS 的 switching comparator/OPT 估计及 optimizer zero-point、谱病态未全覆盖；普通 v2 community 7 轮未高于旧版5轮。

### gap:304

**问题：** I’m building a real‑time, multi‑user gesture interface for a hospital setting that must associate each person’s hands/face to the right body while running under tight GPU memory. The pipeline pretrains with a joint‑embedding self‑supervised method, then fine‑tunes with AdamW/SGD on attention backbones (Transformers or a 50‑layer residual net), evaluates with F1/Precision and log‑loss, and uses cosine scoring on a 100‑class benchmark. I need: (a) an anchor‑free detector that links parts to bodies robustly, (b) a low‑memory optimizer (~4‑bit moments) to shrink training footprint, (c) guidance on designing recurrent modules that obey excitatory/inhibitory constraints yet remain spectrally stable for time‑series modeling, and (d) an online, bandit‑style way to pick among several predictors/heuristics with sublinear regret. Please point me to works that together address these needs and discuss transformer‑style conditional guidance, clean subset evaluation (D_k^c), and near‑linear time implementations.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1/v2 普通模式都 2，fallback 3。该题问题前言确实提 JEPA pretraining，不能把 gold 的 JEPA 自动当多余。普通社区漏整个 JEPA，另有 bandit improper actions/OPT lower bound 等缺项；8–9 轮仍未形成模块覆盖。

### gap:307

<a id="gap-310"></a>

### gap:310

**问题：** I’m building a multi‑modal system where: a camera UI must reliably detect which person’s hands/face to respond to; long‑context reasoning uses retrieval over a graph of text/images via cosine similarity; planning runs over structured states; we pretrain with self‑supervised joint‑embedding objectives but want to understand their implicit bias; our recurrent modules must respect an E/I split yet remain trainable; and we have tight GPU memory so optimizers need 4‑bit states. Using Transformers with attention, lightweight (LoRA‑style) fine‑tuning, and losses like CE/MSE or BPR, what works should I study to design the detector, the graph‑structured world model with conditional generative guidance, the memory‑efficient training recipe, and the spectral analyses to keep learning stable and interpretable?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 只有 v2 naive 到 3，其余 2。GWM token/encoder 依赖和 PBADet enclosure、JEPA collapse/slow-feature 被不同程度遗漏；fallback 2 轮答案还加入额外论文，未改善关键限制。

**关键段落核验：** PBADet 附录 D0063/32 实际返回于 V1N、V2N；v1 两组展示 D0063 overview 时含单部件收益 caveat，v2 同文档 overview 不含该句。 4-bit 零点机制原文（D0059/1、2、8、9 至少一段）返回于 V1N、V1C、V2N、V2C、V2F。

For vision pretraining I’m considering JEPA‑style self‑distillation (cosine similarity/MSE) and want to understand why it learns robust feature embeddings. Finally, the robot should rapidly transfer to new manipulation rewards via self‑supervised RL using random features and MPC. ### gap:319

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively tackle efficient and interpretable deep learning across perception and physical modeling, including: anchor-free part–body association in vision; training EI-constrained recurrent nets under Dale’s principle via spectral analysis; non-contrastive self-distillation (JEPA) that biases latent feature embeddings toward high-influence dimensions; memory-light optimizers that compress Adam/AdamW states to sub-byte levels for parameter-efficient Transformer fine-tuning (e.g., low-rank adapters end-to-end); and adaptive hierarchical graph simulators for time-series meshes. I’m looking for work that discusses squared-error metrics (MSE), cosine-similarity style objectives, cross-entropy loss, regularization trade-offs (quadratic penalties/Pareto), shallow predictors vs. feedforward classifiers, and reports Precision/F1/AUROC. Benchmarks can range from MNIST/ResNet-scale vision to large Transformers.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:322

**问题：** We’re building a resource-constrained robotics pipeline that must: 1) reliably associate hands and faces to the correct person for HMI, 2) fine-tune large Transformers with LoRA under tight GPU memory budgets using compressed-state optimizers, 3) understand why self-distilled representations focus on useful signals rather than noisy pixels, 4) keep recurrent models biologically consistent (excitatory/inhibitory) without killing performance, and 5) run adaptive mesh-based physics simulators that evolve graph hierarchies over time. We plan to evaluate with MSE and cross-entropy, use cosine-style similarity in the embedding space, and track Precision/F1/AUROC. Are there works covering these design and training strategies end-to-end?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 全 2。EvoMesh 未完全分辨率泛化、PBADet 阈值/box-centric 和 optimizer zero-point 等遗漏长期存在，偶有对 OOD 泛化的夸大；不属于 v2 独有回归。

### gap:331

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively address efficient training and transfer across vision and robotics: anchor-free detectors that associate human parts with their parent bodies on common object benchmarks; active exploration for system identification to estimate masses/friction/articulation for sim-to-real control; low-bit (around 4-bit) optimizer states compatible with stochastic gradient and adaptive-moment methods; spectral analyses of excitatory/inhibitory recurrent nets that respect Dale-like constraints; and non-contrastive self-distillation in joint-embedding SSL (JEPA) that biases feature learning. Prefer works using transformer or residual (e.g., 50-layer) backbones, reporting precision/recall/F1 on COCO-style tasks, and comparing losses like mean-squared versus log-softmax, with support for lightweight adapter fine-tuning (low-rank) and regularization.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 两组 3→v2 2/2，fallback 3。ASID 无在线适应、PBADet enclosure 等本质限制，被“没有 Transformer/COCO/LoRA”等偏好不匹配部分替代；应区分论文缺陷与用户偏好未覆盖。

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (1) anchor-free, part-to-body association detectors evaluated with AP/Precision/F1 on COCO-style benchmarks; (2) self-supervised joint-embedding (non-contrastive) methods whose implicit bias is analyzed with cosine similarity and MSE-style objectives; (3) memory-efficient fine-tuning using low-bit AdamW/SGD optimizer states; (4) safety and robustness of Diffusion models, including adversarial image-to-image attacks that bypass cosine-similarity safety checkers; and (5) interpretability and regularization via spectral analysis of deep networks, especially recurrent EI architectures. Ideally include works that discuss practical fine-tuning (e.g., end-to-end LoRA), metrics like cross-entropy and F1, and guidance for stable training on limited hardware.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:340

**问题：** I’m building a resource-constrained vision system for multi-person gesture control that must: accurately associate hands/face with the correct body for downstream actions (evaluated with AP/F1 on COCO-like data); fine-tune large backbones under tight GPU memory using AdamW with quantized states; pretrain with self-supervised joint-embedding objectives and understand their cosine-similarity bias; maintain stable RNN controllers that respect excitatory/inhibitory constraints; and run an image-to-image Diffusion editing module that won’t be fooled by adversarial inputs targeting NSFW filters. Please point me to research that addresses detection architectures, low-bit optimizers for fine-tuning, spectral analysis for EI stability, JEPA-style SSL interpretability, and adversarial I2I attacks against safety checkers.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 4→v2 naive 2，普通 community 3→2，fallback 4。v2 naive 也得到 PBADet 关键附录，但仍在 DANN/MAE bias/量化/攻击条件上漏项，表明精确证据到达之后仍需要采用核验。

**问题：** Help me find a focused set of papers that together address: (1) a one-stage anchor‑free method for associating human parts to people (evaluated on COCO) for detection; (2) how Dale’s Law (excitatory/inhibitory constraints) and spectral properties impact RNN learning under SGD; (3) when joint‑embedding/self‑distillation (JEPA) versus masked reconstruction (MAE) favors learning influential features in deep linear models, analyzed with MSE/CE; (4) memory‑efficient fine‑tuning using 4‑bit states for the Adam optimizer on modern backbones (e.g., Transformers; results on CIFAR‑100/MNIST); and (5) label‑free prediction of out‑of‑distribution performance for fine‑tuned foundation models via agreement among ensemble members, reporting metrics like F1. I’m particularly interested in interpretability links and practical guidance for feature embeddings and large‑scale training.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:346

**问题：** I’m building a vision–language system for an on‑device human–computer interface: we need an anchor‑free detector to associate hands/face to the right person (COCO‑style data), train and fine‑tune Transformers with very limited GPU memory, decide between JEPA‑style self‑distillation and MAE for pretraining features (tracked with MSE/CE), and keep a small RNN controller that respects E/I constraints trained with SGD. Before deployment, I also want to estimate OOD performance without labels (camera shifts, background changes) using agreement within a small ensemble, and monitor F1. Can you point me to works that cover the part‑to‑body detection design, 4‑bit optimizers for Adam, implicit biases of JEPA vs MAE, spectral insights for Dale’s Law, and agreement‑based accuracy prediction for fine‑tuned foundation models?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:355

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively cover: (1) joint-embedding self-supervised learning that biases feature embeddings toward informative signals rather than pixel noise (analyzing why squared-error vs entropy-based classification losses behave differently), (2) memory-lean training using sub-byte (around 4‑bit) optimizer states compatible with Adam‑style and stochastic gradient methods for end-to-end fine‑tuning of Transformers and adapter-based (e.g., low‑rank) updates, (3) an anchor‑free one‑stage approach for associating human parts with people that reports metrics like F1/Precision and uses standard objectives such as squared error or cross‑entropy, and (4) a rank‑based causal discovery framework that allows causally related hidden variables for interpretability. Prefer works that also discuss fine‑tuning on benchmarks (e.g., MNIST, CIFAR‑100) and report practical considerations for evaluation and optimization.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 前四组均 2，fallback 4，但题目明确四主题而 gold 多出 Dale’s Law。fallback judge 明说“不要求该未问主题”，其他 judge 却按遗漏扣分；这是明确的评分范围不一致，不能作为 fallback +2 的纯算法证据。

### gap:364

**问题：** I’m building a resource‑constrained, multi‑modal pipeline: (1) on‑device hand/face association for HCI evaluated on COCO, (2) a chemistry assistant that proposes synthesizable molecules with interpretable substructures, and (3) LoRA end‑to‑end fine‑tuning of Transformers under tight GPU memory. I need research that shows how to use anchor‑free detection, avoid spurious high‑variance pixels via self‑supervised latent‑space prediction, understand how E/I constraints impact RNNs on sequential data, and shrink optimizer memory with 4‑bit Adam/AdamW while maintaining accuracy on MNIST/CIFAR‑100/SVHN and business metrics like Precision/F1. Practical guidance on losses (MSE, cross‑entropy), feature embeddings, and online implementation/diagrams would be ideal.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:367

**问题：** Help me find recent papers that collectively cover: (1) spectral and regularization effects in deep networks trained with SGD, including excitatory/inhibitory constraints in RNNs and tests on MNIST; (2) the implicit bias of self-supervised learning with joint-embedding predictors versus masked reconstruction, contrasting cosine similarity heads and MSE losses in deep linear models and Transformers; (3) memory-efficient fine-tuning using the Adam optimizer with 4-bit state approximations and per-row/column quantization, reporting metrics like F1/Precision on CIFAR-100 and ResNet-50/Swin/Transformer backbones; (4) anchor-free part–body association detectors that go beyond plain cross-entropy via task-alignment regularization; and (5) time-resolved NeRFs that render lidar transients over t for novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

<a id="gap-370"></a>

### gap:370

**问题：** I’m building a robotics stack that needs: hand/body association in crowded scenes, raw single-photon lidar simulation and reconstruction for planning, and memory-lean fine-tuning of large Transformer models. I prefer self-supervised pretraining (JEPA-style) over pixel reconstruction, want to understand how excitatory/inhibitory architectural constraints affect learning, and must train under tight GPU budgets with Adam/SGD while tracking F1/Precision. Are there works that collectively address detection with part–body linking, transient NeRF rendering along time t, 4‑bit optimizer state approximations, and analyses of cosine-similarity vs squared-error objectives on benchmarks like MNIST or CIFAR-100?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 naive 3→v2 2，其余均 2。Transient NeRF impulse-response calibration/曝光/采集实用性及 JEPA shallow encoder、optimizer zero-point 是反复缺项，不能由数据集文档覆盖代替。

### gap:379

**问题：** Help me find research that together spans: (a) one‑stage anchor‑free human part–body association detectors with precise metrics (AP, F1, Precision) and streamlined post‑processing; (b) spectral analyses of biologically‑constrained recurrent nets (excitatory/inhibitory) showing how initialization and stochastic gradient methods shape deep network training under squared‑error or log‑loss; (c) joint‑embedding self‑supervision that predicts latent targets (vs. masked reconstruction) to avoid noisy features, with experiments on classic vision datasets like MNIST, SVHN, and CIFAR‑100; (d) anytime‑valid risk‑controlling prediction sets for low‑risk deployment, including active labeling budgets and e‑process/betting formulations; and (e) instruction tuning of permissively‑licensed code LLMs (using low‑rank adapters or end‑to‑end finetuning) evaluated on HumanEval‑style tasks with feature embeddings, angular similarity, and practical diagrams. I’m also interested in near‑linear runtime discussions, SFT backbones, ResNet‑50 baselines, and clean‑label subsets used for calibration.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** v1 community 3→v2 2，fallback 3。OctoPack 输出长度/targeted edit/CommitPack/语言偏置与 RCPS betting/budget、PBA heavy setup 等未全覆盖；fallback 原文核验恢复一部分。

### gap:388

**问题：** I’m building an end‑to‑end AI stack where: a vision module must associate hands/faces to the right person in crowded scenes (COCO‑style data) with high precision; training must fit tight GPU memory, so I need 4‑bit AdamW/SGD states; pretraining should be self‑supervised but avoid noisy pixel features (favoring latent prediction over pure reconstruction with MSE/cosine alignment); a reasoning agent should decide when to write Python vs natural language, guided by SFT/DPO; and a small RNN for physiological time‑series should respect excitatory/inhibitory constraints with stable spectra. Are there papers that together cover anchor‑free detection, low‑bit optimizers, JEPA‑style implicit bias, Transformer‑based conditional guidance for code/text, and EI RNN spectral analyses, along with practical fine‑tuning (e.g., End‑to‑end LoRA), regularization, and CE vs MSE trade‑offs?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 普通社区跨版本都 3，naive/fallback 2。CodeSteer multi-turn SFT gradient cancellation、DPO reward hacking、token/runtime开销，以及 PBADet/optimizer 细节仍未全写；目标应是机制与边界，不只是论文清单。

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively tackle scalable and reliable deep learning across vision, sequences, and RL: (a) a single-pass, anchor-free detector that associates human parts with the correct person; (b) analyses of recurrent nets that enforce excitatory/inhibitory sign structure and show how the singular-value spectrum at initialization, more than the sign constraints, drives learning; (c) theory for joint-embedding/self-distillation objectives (JEPA-style) in deep linear models explaining why latent prediction with cosine-like similarity and MSE/CE surrogates biases toward high-influence features; (d) memory‑lean training by quantizing Adam/SGD states to around 4 bits with smarter block/row/column scaling and zero‑free quantizers; and (e) a top‑down, LLM‑guided strategy/option generator for RL that turns natural-language subgoals into shaped rewards for Transformer agents. Please include works that discuss regularization, feature embeddings, and report metrics like F1/Precision/AUROC, and that are relevant to time‑series or vision backbones (e.g., ResNet/Transformers) and standard losses (cross‑entropy vs MSE).Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

**逐题判断：** 五组全 2。Strategist plan-to-policy/re-strategizing/safety 与 PBADet 动物泛化、optimizer instability 等既有短板持续存在。v2 普通社区做到 7 轮也没有改善，泛化表述还可能超过证据。

Are there papers that cover these pieces—using Transformers or ResNet backbones, standard regularization, and reporting F1/Precision/AUROC—so I can adapt them as a blueprint?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

### gap:397

**问题：** Help me find papers that collectively tackle memory- and data‑efficient deep networks across diverse tasks: (i) self‑supervised/self‑distillation objectives (e.g., MSE vs cross‑entropy with cosine similarity) for learning feature embeddings; (ii) anchor‑free, attention‑based detection on COCO with reporting in Precision/F1; (iii) memory‑efficient AdamW‑style training with sub‑byte states enabling end‑to‑end LoRA fine‑tuning; (iv) spectral/regularization perspectives for recurrent time‑series modeling (e.g., Dale’s Law) to improve interpretability and stability; and (v) unsupervised methods that learn to solve combinatorial problems like TSP without labels. Preference for works that compare CE vs MSE, use MNIST/COCO‑scale benchmarks, and discuss practical training trade‑offs.Please analyze the development defects of these methods.

Are there papers combining anchor‑free attention detectors, memory‑efficient 4‑bit optimizers, JEPA‑style self‑distillation, EI RNN spectral analyses, and unsupervised local‑search‑guided learning, with evaluations on MNIST/COCO and standard metrics?Please analyze the development defects of these methods.
